descriptions.mangrove: Mangrove — oil persists for years; cleaning causes further damage
descriptions.marsh: Marsh, mudflat or tidal wetland — soft sediment holds oil
descriptions.rocky: Rock or cliff — oil weathers off, access is hard
descriptions.built: Built edge — port structures, straightforward to clean
descriptions.port: Port or harbour — contained water, response equipment at hand
descriptions.coral: Reef — highly sensitive, no mechanical cleaning

note: Each coastline vertex takes the nearest mapped shore feature within the match radius. Stretches with nothing mapped nearby stay unclassified rather than assumed.
